lines.say: Many women skip weights because they don't want to look big.
But women have far less testosterone than men, often more than ten times less. Building big muscle is slow, even for men.
Women do gain muscle and strength well. In studies, their gains compared to their size are about the same as men's.
What they usually get: a firmer shape, stronger bones, and better posture, not giant muscles.
Verdict: myth. The big bodybuilders you see trained for years, ate for it, and some used drugs.
So pick up the weights. Getting strong is a superpower.
